assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: transparent 2D story character sprite for the original game William's Paradox.
INPUT1 is the EDIT TARGET, authoritative ONLY for character identity, exact pose, facial emotion, props, composition and asset framing. INPUT2 is the canonical new fullbody model for proportions/linework. INPUT3 approved R04 is the authoritative Choa FACE/EYE and rich cel-color reference. INPUT4 approved R03 supports the same graphic style in a different scene. The user explicitly APPROVED these two rich-colored references; preserve their color, NOT the rejected v18 unshaded or icon-eye style.

Redraw the SAME blonde human-faced bunny girl CHOA. Preserve long angular blonde twin tails, white rabbit ears with pink interiors, green clover clip, orange bow, white blouse, orange apron-dress with white apron/hem bands, gold circular fasteners, white ankle socks, giant orange-white geometric platform shoes. Same underlying3.5–4-head cartoon body from INPUT2 excluding ears/hair/accessories: large angular head, compact short torso, dramatically long slim forearms and shins, narrow wrists/ankles, oversized expressive hands and substantial shoes. Preserve the exact old action and pose, including bent/foreshortened views, while keeping the same underlying body model. NO two-head child/chibi redesign, NO realistic adult fashion figure.

Match the strong graphic sensibility of Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt with appealing anime faces. Very thick crisp almost-black NAVY angular exterior contour, thinner simpler interior facial/clothing lines. Long straight segments, wedges/trapezoids and decisive corner changes in jaw/hair/elbows/knees/hems. Hair as a few large angular masses, no fine strands. Choa's eyes must use the approved R04 green almond construction: heavy solid dark upper lids, pointed wedge outer lashes, slightly raised outer corners, same face-relative eye scale and spacing. Keep the old emotion through brow angle, lid openness, mouth and gaze rather than inventing a different eye design. Simple iris and pupil with ONE crisp white eye glint when eyes are open, no complex rings/bands or excessive sparkle. Do not substitute tiny icon eyes, enormous circular doll eyes or dead eyes. Naturally closed laughing eyes stay closed.

Rich vivid blonde-yellow/orange/green and ivory are required. Broad clean flat BASE COLOR + ONE clearly bounded hard CEL SHADOW per material, optional tiny thirdstep only where truly needed. Lavender/navy shadows on whites, restrained warm-violet skin shadow, ochre blonde shadow and burnt-orange orange shadow, matching approved references. Large triangle/trapezoid/polygon shadow planes, not a patchwork of tiny facets on every fold. Keep ample clean base areas and readable face. NO washed-out monochrome/unshaded treatment, NO airbrush/gradient-dominated coloring, painterly texture/grain, glossy 3D skin, glow/bloom/rimlight or cast ground shadow.

Single character cutout only. GENUINE alpha0 transparent background and holes, no opaque backdrop/checkerboard/soft halo. All silhouette extremities and props fully inside canvas with clear margin; preserve framing category (fullbody vs waist-up) of INPUT1. No scene, extra props/people, labels/text/UI/logo/watermark. Final original generated PNG bytes will be used directly.
POSE INVARIANT: Preserve weary slumped standing pose, both hands holding laundry/picnic basket with folded cloth, mouth small and tired; do not remove or replace basket.
assets.review: Viewed generation at native presentation: approved rich orange/blonde and ivory/lavender cel colors, heavy angular contour and repeatable Choa green almond eye family. Exact original pose/prop/emotion preserved. True alpha and edge checks pass; surrounding preview RGB is hidden where alpha0, not an opaque backdrop.
